message.peterwolfs_forestfire.incident_a: INCIDENT ALERT: %s near %s, %s, %s — respond with pump, hose and command post.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.pump_damag: Pump is damaged and cannot start.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.pump_no_fu: Pump has no fuel. Use a Pump Fuel Can.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: No pressurised hose nearby. Deploy attack line from the pump.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_nee: No fire hose nearby (8 blocks). Lay Fire Hose from the pump, then right-click the hose or the ground next to it with the nozzle.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: No pump pressure. Check intake, fuel and pump state.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_pic: Nozzle picked up — hold use to spray. Shift-use ground to place.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_pla: Nozzle placed on the ground. Water closed.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_clo: Close the nozzle (release use) before disconnecting.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_in_: Another firefighter is operating this nozzle.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_orp: Nozzle link lost — reconnect to a hose.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.nozzle_no_: Cannot drop a connected nozzle. Shift-place on ground or disconnect at hose.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.hose_maxim: Hose at maximum length — cannot go further.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.backpack_e: Backpack sprayer empty. Sneak-use near water to refill.
message.peterwolfs_forestfire.kit_given: Firefighter kit granted (%s stacks). Full gear, tools, pump, hoses and fuel.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.peterwolf: Dedicated to all firefighters who risk their lives protecting forests, wildlife and communities.
